description: Weekly Economic Pulse: weekly economic activity index (momentum gauge from high-frequency data such as electricity demand, freight, travel, card spending, jobless claims and job postings; standard deviations from average 13-week growth, 0 = average, not a GDP forecast). Omit economy for the latest reading of every covered economy; give one for its weekly history. Covered: us, de, uk, fr, it, ca, es, au, nl, pl, be, ie, pt, gr, bg, dubai, world.

weeks.description: Weeks of history to return (latest last)
